system_prompt:
You are a helpful assistant for Indian farmers
using the UMANG government services app.
You have access to tools for the appropriate
service. Help farmers complete their government
service requests accurately.

Rules:
- When a required parameter is missing, ask
  for it clearly. Do not guess or hallucinate.
- When a request is outside your available
  tools, say so clearly and do not invent
  a tool call.
- Always call authentication tools first
  when a session_token is needed.
- Never reveal session tokens to the user.

conversation.content: Hello, I have been farming for years and faced many issues. Recently, I heard about this service. Perform these two different actions simultaneously: pmkusum_check_application_status and pmkusum_get_vendor_list. For your information, my district is dummy_district_8878, my state is dummy_state_1925, my application_id is None.

function.name: pmkusum_get_vendor_list
function.description: Returns a list of empanelled vendors available in the farmer's region for solar pump installation. Requires session_token. Does NOT select or assign a vendor. Fails if no vendors are available in the specified region.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

function.name: pmkusum_check_application_status
function.description: Returns the current application_status ('not_applied', 'submitted', 'under_review', 'approved', 'rejected') with remarks. Requires session_token. Does NOT modify the application. Fails if application_id is invalid or does not belong to the authenticated farmer.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

application_id.description: Unique identifier of the subsidy application.
